title: Release Ephemeris: Shift Cadence, Pocket Calendar, and Notes (May 2026) - Draft
content:
Purpose
This is a compact operational pocket ephemeris for the May 2026 mini-release (soft launch lane). Not a canonical runbook — think 'day-of pocket map' + staffing cadence + quick rollback heuristics. Use this to shepherd micro-rollouts and hand off to on-call.

High-level window
- Launch window: 2026-05-12 17:00-20:00 UTC (primary), 2026-05-13 02:00-05:00 UTC (APAC warm-up)
- Quiet window: no batch jobs, no infra patching +/- 48h around window
- Traffic ramp: 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 90m if gates pass

Staffing / shift cadence (pocket rota)
- T-4h: preflight (Marta) — final smoke checklist run, telemetry baseline snapshot.
- T-1h: staging-to-prod handoff (Ethan + SRE): confirm canary route, K/V cache warmers enabled.
- Launch: lead + two observers (Priya on telemetry, Jonah on ops comms).
- Post-launch +6h: stabilization handover to nightwatch (Sofia).
- Escalation ladder: Lead -> Release Eng TL -> SRE Pager -> Eng oncall (documented in #release-control)

Preflight quick checklist (must pass)
- [ ] Canary infra checks green (cpu/gpu avail, memory pressure < 60%)
- [ ] Canary perf: p50/p95 tokens within guardrail (p95 < 420ms for 512 tokens)
- [ ] E2E smoke: text-gen, chat function-call, embeddings sample request — golden responses verified
- [ ] Telemetry hooks (trace IDs) wired to traces and logs (OBS-334)
- [ ] Rollout toggle and emergency kill (feature-flag) validated by team member other than deployer

Gating and telemetry sampling plan
- Sampling spec: 100% short requests, 10% long-form sampling (>=1024 tokens) to catch regressions
- Alerts: error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m, latency spike p95 > 2x baseline for 5m -> auto-hold and page SRE
- Quality guard: rouge token divergence measured against control model for sampled prompts; if > 8% novelty rate -> hold rollout and open REL-9123

Smoke tests (quick)
1) /v1/generate — sample prompt -> expected suffix exists
2) Chat function call -> returned tool payload matches schema
3) Embeddings -> cosine similarity on sample corpus (sanity threshold 0.87)
4) KV-cache sanity -> subsequent prompt with prefix should be faster (p50 delta < 30ms)

Rollback & roll-forward heuristics
- Soft hold: automatic traffic hold at toggle if p95 crosses threshold
- Manual rollback: full-rollback to previous pinned model version if error-rate remains > 0.5% after 12m of mitigation attempts
- Emergency fallback: route to regional warm pool (Dedicated variant) for customers with SLA tier — documented in comms playbook

Communications
- Primary channel: #release-control (Slack). Escalation page: /call 10s if SEV event
- Post-deploy note template (paste into #release-control): short summary, window, canary metric snapshot, any outstanding tickets

Known risks + mitigations
- Risk: KV cache pressure -> mitigation: pre-warm prefixes, enable cache-trimming for low-value keys
- Risk: sudden token-cost spike from retry storms -> mitigation: rate-limit backoffs + circuit-breaker enabled
- Risk: regional infra flare -> mitigation: smart-routing to fallback region (must validate cross-region data residency for Private customers)

TODO / open questions (notes to self)
- Confirm APAC warm pool capacity with infra (SRE) — pinged in OBS-334 (priority)
- Confirm short-request sampling instrumentation in hosted API (ask Priya to validate end-to-end)
- Add pre-commit checklist item to PR template to attach perf snapshots (follow-up: GH PR #421)

Post-release (first 24h) checklist
- +30m: first quick retrospective in #release-control (5m)
- +6h: snapshot telemetry export (retain 24h for debugging)
- +24h: debrief doc (owner: Marta) with lessons, regression notes, and tickets (link in Confluence)

Notes
This doc is intentionally compact — carry it in your tab. If you need the canonical long-form runbook, see the runbook index in Confluence (linked_artifacts). Use this as the operational checklist for small launches where low friction and rapid rollback are the priority.

End of pocket ephemeris (draft)
